title: Exploding Wood
description: This is a mod that adds wood that explodes. It adds custom tools that has custom settings to make things explode when certain things are done! I don't have all variants of wood but I'm working on it!
body:
WARNING: THIS MOD IS NOT INTENDED TO BE PLAYED IN HARDCORE MODE!!! IF SOMETHING HAPPENS AND YOU LOSE A LONG HARDCORE WORLD I SAID ITS NOT MEANT FOR HARDCORE YOU ARE THE ONE TO BE AT FAULT! THIS IS A WARNING.


This adds exploding wood and is almost undetectable, it adds a special tree with the special oak log that I have added to the game! I used MCreator to make this mod and it took about 3 Hours.

It also adds custom tools but they are really just normal wood tools with special abilities. I'm working on adding more variants. I really hope you enjoy this mod that came out of a random idea I had and I then made it come to life!
